Cohorts: Anevia Tirabade, Aron Kir, Aravashnial, Irabeth Tirabade, Sir Ilivan, Sosiel Vaenic

Characters may not start at, move, or be moved to locations that have the Abyssal trait until all locations that do not have the Abyssal trait are closed; when you move to an occupied location that has the Abyssal trait, summon and encounter the henchman Minagho. If you defeat a non-henchman, non-villain monster in a location that does not have the Abyssal trait, shuffle it into a random open location that has the Abyssal trait.
